Explore how climate change is influencing extreme fire-weather risk in southeastern Australia.

This blog translates climate attribution research into accessible insights for local government and emergency management professionals. It examines the evidence from the 2019–20 Australian bushfire season, explains the uncertainties, and considers what the findings mean for long-term preparedness.
